description: Read one public web page. Use audit (default) for HTTP status, security-header grade, TLS and email DNS signals. Use markdown for page text, title, links and truncation status. Both modes fetch the supplied URL and follow public redirects.

mode.description: Choose audit for configuration signals or markdown to extract readable content.

url.description: Absolute public HTTP or HTTPS page URL, e.g. https://example.org/. Use a URL accessible without credentials.

name: audit_website_and_markdown
